title: Create Ralph Board tab shell with view toggle
userStory: As a developer, I want a new 'Ralph Board' tab in the dashboard with kanban and list view options so that I can visualize tasks in my preferred format.
acceptanceCriteria: New tab labeled 'Ralph Board' appears in dashboard navigation
Kanban view shows columns for each state: Draft, Triage, Planning, Ready, Executing, Complete
List view shows tasks in a table with sortable columns
Empty state displays helpful onboarding message
